text:
maya: CI red on linux-shard-12 after the toolchain bump. link errors complaining about missing generated headers (symlink targets).

maya: example error: 
```
ld: error: cannot find -lgen_headers/foo.h (No such file or directory)
// actually fails at compile: include file not found: generated/foo.pb.h
```

maya: I haven't touched BUILD files in that area, just FYI. Any quick ideas? @jon @lee

jon: ugh. seen something similar when our genrule output moved to a different execroot path after the gcc image changed. symlinks got broken.

lee: can you paste the failing `bazel build` command and the `bazel-bin` tree? also which toolchain image did we roll to?

maya: `bazel test //lib/proto:all --config=linux --test_output=errors`

maya: we rolled to `gcc-13-prod-image` yesterday per the infra roll PR.

jon: ok the gcc bump is a likely suspect. quick triage: can you run `bazel query 'kind(genrule, //lib/proto:*)'` and `bazel aquery --include_artifacts //lib/proto:all` and paste outputs?

maya: running now, pasting snippets: 
```
$ bazel query 'kind(genrule, //lib/proto:*)'
//lib/proto:generate_protos

$ bazel aquery --include_artifacts //lib/proto:all | sed -n '1,120p'
…
action (Id: 4523, mnemonic: GenRule) outputs: bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/lib/proto/generated/foo.pb.h -> symlink to ../../../../external/gen/tool/foo.pb.h
```

sam: if the genrule output is pointing at an external path, maybe the external workspace layout changed with the new toolchain. Did the toolchain image rename a path or change mount points?

olga: CI logs show the compile happening in a sandboxed execroot; symlink targets that point outside the execroot fail. we had a similar sandboxing change in the new image.

jon: quick experiment: try `bazel build --experimental_sandbox_base=/tmp/sandbox-test //lib/proto:generate_protos` locally or on a dev-host to see if symlink resolution differs. if that reproduces, it's definitely sandbox/path differences.

maya: queued a rerun of the failing CI shard with the `--sandbox_debug` flag via the rerun bot. @ci-bot can you run: `bazel test //lib/proto:all --config=linux --test_output=errors --sandbox_debug` on shard 12?

ci-bot: Scheduled rerun for shard 12 with additional flags. Link: https://ci.internal/rebuilds/7264 :gear:

maya: while that's running, can someone suggest a short-term workaround for the PR? we need to green the main branch.

lee: short term: update the genrule to copy outputs into the execroot-relative path instead of creating symlinks to external mounts. hacky but fast. alternative: revert the toolchain bump in infra and gate a follow-up investigation.

jon: I can draft a tiny genrule wrapper that `cp`'s the headers into `$(GENDIR)` instead of symlinking. we should only apply to affected protos.

maya: agree. if CI rerun confirms sandbox issue, let's do the cp workaround and open a tracked bug for proper fix. I'll assign to @jon.

sam: ping @olga for infra follow-up—if the image changed sandbox behavior we need a release note and maybe a compat test.

olga: noted. I'll open infra ticket and add a smoke test for execroot symlinking on the toolchain images.

maya: thanks all. CI rerun finished: still failing, same error. go ahead @jon for the cp workaround PR and @olga please file infra ticket. :thumbsup:

jon: will do, sending a small PR in ~30m and cc'ing eng-infra.

maya: closing this thread for now, will link PR and infra ticket in a followup thread.
